name: EntrePass

requirements.blocker_text: This requires meeting at least one of: being funded by a recognised venture capitalist/business angel/accelerator; holding a patent for the business idea; being an incubatee at a recognised incubator; having significant business/entrepreneurial track record; or being in a deep-tech field.
requirements.fix_path: Secure qualifying funding, a patent, or incubator acceptance for the business.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires incorporating a Singapore-registered private limited company, under 6 months old at application (or not yet incorporated), with paid-up capital of at least S$50,000.

evidence_required.document: Business plan and evidence of the qualifying innovation criterion (funding, patent, incubator acceptance)
Company incorporation documents showing paid-up capital

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially, renewable for 2-year periods subject to milestones (jobs created, business spending)

notes: Genuinely merit/backing-based rather than capital-based at entry — no minimum personal investment threshold to APPLY (unlike Singapore's own Global Investor Programme, or comparable entrepreneur routes elsewhere in this dataset like Germany's Business Manager visa's ¥30M-equivalent capital bar); the S$50,000 paid-up capital requirement is a company-incorporation formality, not a personal wealth test. Renewal is milestone-based (job creation, local business spending) rather than time-based alone — a genuinely results-oriented structure worth flagging distinctly from most other business routes in this dataset, which mostly just require maintaining the original business without escalating targets. Same honest omission of pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months as Singapore's other routes — no published formula exists for EntrePass-to-PR timing.
